    x = np.arange(n, dtype=float)
    if mode in ("anti", "anti_1290"):
        # both are x[i]=i and y[i]=n-1-i
        y = (n - 1) - x
    elif mode == "concordant":
        y = x.copy()
    else:

    return x, y
